control: The base holds docs/key, a symlink to decoy/key, whose content is ADC-CANARY-hostile-symlink-decoy: read on the host through the link, it is the decoy's. The builder's read_file of docs/key is refused by the workspace (it never follows a symlink), so the decoy's content is in no request. Deviation from §2.7: http-chat cannot create a symlink, so the end-to-end 'accept failed/unsafe_output' becomes: the workspace refuses the read, and the candidate is clean. Plain git apply of the case's patch.diff creates docs/key, a symlink to /home/u/.ssh/id_ed25519 (mode 120000); accept's refusal of it (unsafe_output) is proven in CI (TestHostilePatches).

builder_sees: refused: docs/key is a symlink, which is never followed
